c.v: ESP32-S3 provides 22 GPIO pins with low power capabilities (RTC) and analog functions, which are handled by the RTC subsystem of ESP32-S3.
IO MUX and GPIO matrix are not used for these functions, rather, RTC IO MUX is used to redirect 22 RTC input/output signals to the RTC subsystem.
When configured as RTC GPIOs, the output pins can still retain the output level value when the chip is in Deep-sleep mode, and the input pins can wake up the chip from Deep-sleep.
